title: LLM-ENABLED MULTI-AGENT SYSTEMS: EMPIRICAL EVALUATION AND INSIGHTS INTO EMERGING DESIGN PATTERNS & PARADIGMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on architectural design patterns and paradigms for LLM-enabled multi-agent systems and evaluates their utility through three case studies. While it includes brief sections on ethical considerations and future work related to governance, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component.
